create_a2a_client: create an A2A client for a given agent URL with configurable timeout and extra headers
asend_message: send a message to an A2A agent asynchronously with retry logic and token usage logging
send_message: send a message to an A2A agent synchronously with LiteLLM logging integration
asend_message_streaming: send a streaming message to an A2A agent asynchronously with chunk iteration and retry on localhost errors
aget_agent_card: fetch the agent card from an A2A agent given its base URL with configurable timeout
